Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks · Household, washing & chores

wipe verb

also clean up, wipe clean

classical

tergeō, tergēre, tersī, tersum

verb, second conjugation

wipe clean or dry

Other words

  • dētergeō, dētergēre, dētersī, dētersum — wipe off or clean

    verb, second conjugation · classical

  • extergeō, extergēre — wipe clean or dry

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical

  • tergō, tergere — wipe clean or dry

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical

  • pertergō, pertergere, pertersī, pertersum — wipe thoroughly

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 389

Examples

  • Linteum affer; mēnsam tergāmus.

    Bring a cloth; let’s wipe the table.composed

  • Urceum statim ēluāmus et mēnsam extergeāmus.

    Let’s rinse the jug immediately and wipe the table.composed

  • Mēnsam dētergē.

    Wipe the table.composed

  • Manūs terge.

    Wipe your hands.composed

  • mēnsam pertergere

    wipe off the tableTraupman 389

See also cloth, rinse, dry, sponge, rag, dry yourself, clean.
